get_dummy_coco_dataset: get a dummy COCO dataset object with all 80 class labels for demo use
list_coco_classes: list all COCO class names from the dummy dataset by iterating over ds.classes values
check_class_count: check the number of COCO classes in the dummy dataset by calling len on ds.classes
lookup_class_by_index: lookup a COCO class name by its index using the dummy dataset classes dictionary
run_demo_without_dataset: run a detection demo without downloading real datasets by using the dummy COCO dataset
